errors.evidence: The chart contains five groups of bars, not four. Each group corresponds to one of the five test sets on the x-axis (Test1 through Test5).
The legend is located at the top center of the chart, not the top right corner.

The WER for the '无' (light green) feature is only around 36% for Test1. For other test sets, the value is lower, dropping to about 29% for Test5. The single value is not representative of the whole series.
The WER values for the 'i-vector' method range from approximately 26% (in Test5) to 30.5% (in Test1). The stated range of 28%-30% is too narrow and misses the lower values.

The WER values for the 'd-vector' method range from approximately 22% (in Test5) to 26.5% (in Test1). The stated range of 24%-26% is too narrow and misses both the lowest and highest values in the series.

The WER values for the 's-vector' method range from approximately 20.5% (in Test5) to 25.5% (in Test1). The stated range of 20%-22% is inaccurate and misses the higher values for this series, particularly in Test1 and Test2.
